purpose: Challenge the exact Campaign103 temporal complete-library mechanism and its support predicate before reading a Campaign103 value.

selected_mechanism.name: full_numeric_library_directional_rank_improvement_breadth_130f
selected_mechanism.dependency_acknowledged: Every input is an old frozen numeric definition. Independence is claimed for the temporal breadth operator, not for new raw data.
selected_mechanism.invariance: Adding the same component-specific offset to both sessions without changing their ordering leaves that component vote unchanged; changing a current level without crossing its prior level need not change the candidate.
selected_mechanism.nonidentity_witness: Two stocks can have identical current-session static consensus or fitted current score but opposite improvement breadth because their prior-session component vectors differ.

overlap_challenges.family: Campaign044 and Campaign101 static complete-library aggregation
overlap_challenges.reason: Those mechanisms aggregate current directional levels. Campaign103 compares every component with its own exact-prior directional rank and aggregates only the signs of change; it does not retry a mean, lower quartile, quantile, or static vote.
Campaign103 reads no training target, learns no coefficient, uses no lambda or bound, selects no subset, and gives every observed component pair one equal vote.

Campaign056 compares two 240-bin within-stock amount distributions with Jensen-Shannon similarity. Campaign103 compares 130 heterogeneous cross-sectional directional ranks and rewards improvement rather than temporal shape similarity.

Campaign060 votes on same-clock signs of 238 intraday returns and rewards repetition. Campaign103 votes on changes in 130 factor ranks and rewards broad relative improvement; it reads no minute return or clock position.

overlap_challenges.family: single-factor lag, delta, acceleration, announcement-improvement, or prior-quarter definitions
overlap_challenges.reason: No source definition is altered or individually differenced in raw units. The sole statistic is an equal breadth vote over the complete frozen 130-factor rank library.

passed_support_anchors.relationship: Each single-session row uses the exact immutable 98-of-130 support with prior median/P05 coverage 0.9981238257410756/0.992066409032738. Campaign103 adds only exact calendar adjacency and the matching instrument row; it does not tune a component threshold from new values.

An exact-prior-session mechanism previously retained 1,329,886 of 1,331,759 quality/listing rows and passed coverage, showing that calendar adjacency alone is not the failed Campaign060 nonzero-return predicate. This is prior immutable support evidence, not Campaign103 tuning.
